functions.docs: Returns download priority. Only valid if a download has been requested and is not yet complete.

functions.name: SetDownloadPriority
functions.docs:
Set download priority. Only valid if a download has been requested and is not yet complete.
@return true if the priority could be set.

functions.name: ReleaseHandle
functions.docs:
Release this handle. This can be called from normal gameplay code to indicate that the loaded assets are no longer needed
This will be called implicitly if all shared pointers to this handle are destroyed
If called before the completion delegate, the release will be delayed until after completion

functions.name: CancelHandle
functions.docs:
Cancel a request, callable from within the manager or externally
This will immediately release the handle even if it is still in progress, and call the cancel callback if bound
This stops the completion callback from happening, even if it is in the delayed callback queue

functions.name: StartStalledHandle
functions.docs: Tells a stalled handle to start its actual request.

functions.name: HasCancelDelegate

functions.name: HasUpdateDelegate

functions.name: BindCompleteDelegate
functions.docs: Bind delegate that is called when load completes, only works if loading is in progress. This will overwrite any already bound delegate!

functions.name: BindCancelDelegate
functions.docs: Bind delegate that is called if handle is canceled, only works if loading is in progress. This will overwrite any already bound delegate!

functions.name: BindUpdateDelegate
functions.docs: Bind delegate that is called periodically as request updates, only works if loading is in progress. This will overwrite any already bound delegate!
